arb_summary.primary_finding: Of 10 observed cross-asset relationships, 0 qualify as strong causal candidates, 2 require further validation, 2 show no causal evidence with available data.

dxy_return_1.economic_rationale: Immediate USD pressure is the primary cross-asset antagonist to gold.
evidence: Lag causality: STRONG at lag 1 (immediate horizon, persistent)

alternative_explanations: Fully mediated by macro_pressure — may not be independently causal
dxy_return_20.economic_rationale: Trend-horizon DXY context shapes institutional gold positioning.

dxy_return_5.economic_rationale: Five-day DXY momentum captures whether USD strength is building or fading.
evidence: Lag causality: MODERATE at lag 3 (short horizon, transient)

fed_surprise.economic_rationale: Unanticipated policy surprises immediately reprice gold relative to real rates.
evidence: Causal stability: STABLE across rolling windows

alternative_explanations: Fully mediated by macro_pressure — may not be independently causal
forward_expectation.economic_rationale: Blends yield curve change, Fed surprise, and DXY trend to proxy institutional forward expectations.

geo_severity.economic_rationale: Geopolitical stress elevates safe-haven demand and can break normal cross-asset correlations.

macro_pressure.economic_rationale: Composite of DXY, yield, and Fed signals that captures the regime-defining macro environment.
evidence: Lag causality: MODERATE at lag 3 (short horizon, transient)

yield_10y_change_5.economic_rationale: Rising real rates suppress gold opportunity cost; falling rates support it.
evidence: Causal stability: STABLE across rolling windows

yield_30y_change_20.economic_rationale: Long-end yield trends anchor institutional duration and macro regime assessment.
evidence: Causal stability: STABLE across rolling windows

yield_curve_10y_3m.economic_rationale: Yield curve shape reflects growth and recession expectations that drive safe-haven demand.
evidence: Causal stability: STABLE across rolling windows

data_limitations.granger_limitation: Granger causality establishes predictive precedence, not structural causation. Structural causal models (SCM) deferred pending additional dataset acquisition.
data_limitations.note: Causal conclusions are limited to governed local datasets (XAU, DXY, Yields, Calendar, Geopolitical). VIX, equity indices, metals, and FX pairs are not locally available — 14 gaps documented in Phase 1.
